contracts: ARM64EC allows x64 and Arm64EC code to interoperate in one process
ARM64EC indirect calls use call checkers and exit thunks for architecture routing
fast-forward sequences are small x64 functions that transfer execution to the real Arm64EC function
ordinary ARM64EC exports may be FFS-resolved to native EC targets
native system services use Nt and Zw entrypoints and user-mode applications reach them through system calls
Nt* syscall exports in SbieLow are routed through local syscall-wrapper state rather than ordinary FFS-only export resolution
WOW64 injection resolves 32-bit ntdll Nt* exports from ntdll_wow64_base
native and ARM64EC injection use pre-captured native or EC entrypoints from SBIELOW_DATA
NtDeviceIoControlFile may point to the EC wrapper installed by PrepSyscalls
this SREV must not change injection pointer assignments or detour patch behavior
